qualityRule: Animation must clarify sequence, causality, focus, or comparison; never animate every object by default.
performanceRule: Prefer opacity and transform; avoid animating layout dimensions, top/left, filters on large surfaces, or many box-shadows.
interruptibility: Animations must settle safely when the user advances, goes backward, changes slide, or enables reduced motion.
editorPreview: Provide preview, replay, duration, delay, trigger, and remove-animation controls when animation editing is enabled.
